title: Norwegian Fennel Bake with Quietly Baked Salmon
description: A simple and flavorful dish originating from Norway, featuring a delicate salmon fillet baked to perfection with fennel and a touch of Norwegian flair.
instructions: Rinse the salmon fillet and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the salmon with salt and black pepper.
In a baking dish, arrange the sliced fennel in a single layer.
Place the salmon fillet on top of the fennel.
dot the top of the salmon with butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
